title: Death of Apophis III (Agag) and the anointing of David
summary: CFAH identifies the Hyksos king Apophis with Agag the Amalekite, put to death by Samuel in the year Samuel anointed David.
description: CFAH identifies the Hyksos king Apophis with Agag the Amalekite, put to death by Samuel in the year Samuel anointed David. Recorded from a CFAH OSF preprint anchor point (not yet published in ARJ). Added by the CFAH pass.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 1: CFAH anchor point: 1074 BC (AP-64, OSF preprint CFAH-8)

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-8: Placing Dynasties 15-18," OSF preprint v1.2 (29 Apr 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/Z5RTD, file CFAH-8_v1.2.pdf, p. 19 ("Anchor Point #64, The Death of Apophis III and Anointing of King David in 1074 BC")
chronologies.note: CFAH follows Velikovsky in identifying Apophis with Agag, killed by Samuel in the year David was anointed.
